name: Traveler.md
description:
Traveler.md gives Claude a memory for how you actually travel.

This connector links Claude to your Traveler.md, a portable file that captures your travel preferences: how you like to fly, where you like to stay, what you eat, how you pace a trip, who you travel with. Instead of re-explaining yourself in every conversation, Claude loads your travel memory and plans with your preferences already in mind.

What Claude can do with this connector:
* Read your Traveler.md so recommendations reflect your real preferences from the first message
* Update your travel preferences when Claude learns something new about how you travel
* List, read, create, and update your trips, so itineraries, bookings, and plans stay organized in Trip.md files as they evolve

You stay in control. Your Traveler.md belongs to you, not to any single platform. Access uses OAuth with granular scopes, so you approve exactly what Claude can read or change. Disconnect at any time; your travel memory stays yours.

Great for:
* Planning trips without repeating your preferences every time
* Keeping a running record of trips in progress
* Getting recommendations that account for your loyalty programs, seat preferences, and travel style
* Carrying one travel profile across every tool in your planning process

To get started, connect Traveler.md, sign in or create a free account, and authorize access. Claude will load your preferences and trips automatically when travel comes up.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Traveler.md to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Traveler.md to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.traveler.md/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Traveler.md MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traveler.md provides these MCP tools: create_profile, create_trip, list_trips, read_profile, read_trip, update_profile, and update_trip.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Traveler.md?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Traveler.md in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Traveler.md requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Traveler.md is developed by TravelAI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
